name: AlgoGuru
summary: A full-stack competitive programming platform — live at algoguru.online, built and shipped end-to-end as sole developer.
description: AlgoGuru is a competitive programming learning platform I designed, built, and deployed end-to-end. It pairs curated interactive problem sets with an in-browser Java playground, role-based authentication, and progress tracking — then layers an AI tutor on top for contextual guidance. I owned the complete product lifecycle: architecture, implementation, deployment, and domain configuration.
features: Java Playground — write, run and iterate on solutions in the browser.
Role-based authentication with per-user progress tracking.
Interactive, curated problem sets across data structures and algorithms.
Guru Bot — an AI tutor using RAG for contextual problem-solving guidance.
role: Sole developer — architecture, implementation, deployment, domain.
